title: Development for CHDO Single Family Home Development
short_description: Houston seeks nonprofit CHDO developers for resilient, energy-efficient single-family homes.
project_scope: Certification of qualified nonprofit Community Housing Development Organizations and development of new resilient, energy-efficient single-family homes for sale to income-eligible first-time homebuyers using HOME Investment Partnerships Program funds. The source does not state the number of homes, site size, gross floor area, or structural dimensions.
services: Design-build/developer services, interior design/space planning, programming, housing and urban development, redevelopment planning, and structural engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a housing development/program funding solicitation rather than a defined structural engineering project.
- Focus is on single-family residential buildings, which are generally not a core sbp target area.
- No indication of complex long-span, bridge, roof, facade, tower, or special structural challenges.
- Structural engineering is listed, but only as one discipline among broad development services.
- Could offer limited relevance through resilient and energy-efficient design aspects, but overall fit is low.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the source. Relevant cost-related information: HOME-funded development of new resilient, energy-efficient single-family homes by certified nonprofit CHDOs; contract base period 24 months with 12-month renewal option. No number of units, sizes, or per-unit budgets are provided, so a realistic estimate is not possible.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated in the source. Because the scope is a broad developer/CHDO solicitation without defined building quantities, sizes, or engineering scope, a realistic structural engineering fee estimate is not possible.
references_qualifications: Applicants must be qualified nonprofit organizations seeking certification as Community Housing Development Organizations (CHDOs). The notice indicates requested disciplines including design-build/developer, interior design/space planning, programming, housing and urban development, redevelopment planning, and structural engineering. No specific minimum reference counts or detailed qualification thresholds are stated in the source.
award_criteria: Not stated in the source. Participation goals include Minority-Owned Business Enterprise, Small Business Enterprise, Woman-Owned Business Enterprise, and Service Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business; prevailing wage may apply.
